# Pixel Creative Agency — llms.txt
# https://pixelcreativeagency.net

## About
Pixel Creative Agency is a creative and communication agency based in Batna, Algeria, founded in 2018.
It works across Algeria in French, Arabic and English, through seven studios.

## Services and public prices (Algerian dinars, DA)
- Pixel Creative (graphic design & print): logo design, brand identity, restaurant menus (from 350 DA each), flyers, roll-ups, stickers; printing on sticker, PVC banner and One Way Vision at 1,800 DA per m².
- Pixel Enseigne (signage): illuminated signs, cut-out letters, LED neon; Forex from 2,500 DA/m², Alucobond from 5,000 DA/m², PMMA 7,000 DA/m², LED modules from 50 DA each.
- Pixel Events (weddings): six wedding photo & video packages from 29,000 DA (Rose) to 130,000 DA (Orchidée); extras: drone 14,000 DA, photobook A4 7,000 DA.
- Pixel Photo Lab: product, food, portrait, fashion and event photography; video production; social media content.
- Pixel Dev: showcase websites, e-commerce, mobile apps; domain, hosting and maintenance included; payment 20 % / 30 % / 50 %.
- Pixel Sounds: voice-over in French, English, Arabic and Darija from 5,000 DA; original soundtracks.
- Tapini (NFC): NFC PVC business cards from 3,500 DA, NFC stickers 2,000 DA, Google review cards.
